features.summary: Firefox’s layout engine received a broad set of fixes and improvements, especially for CSS `line-clamp` (limiting text to a set number of lines), grid and flex sizing, and positioned content. Several other updates address text rendering, scrolling, and accessibility, alongside internal maintenance.
